decision: CONSENT. The subject is unmoved at 271eebc0 mode 0444, the frozen turn-1 subject is unmoved at 1d568b0d mode 0444, HEAD and last live heading are as stated, and all 19 cited digests plus HEAD recompute with zero mismatches. Both corpus v1 Stage A verdicts are ACCEPT 0/0 at mode 0444. The one turn-1 class lands cleanly: Decision item 2 now reads 'four unlabeled observationsNotFindings objects, each an observation paired with a whyNotAFinding', which is exactly the shape of the live bytes at ad9234df — a 4-element list of dicts keyed {'observation','whyNotAFinding'} with no 'id' — and the count, the absence of identifiers, the no-change standing and the four disposition rows are all preserved as turn 1 required. Both CLAUDE-D241-SF1 and CODEX-D241-SF1 appear as their own rows in the disposition table. The full diff against the frozen turn-1 subject is six hunks, every one attributable to turn-2 scaffolding or the remedy, with no row, token, count or denial moved; the incidental tightening to 'Both independent Stage A reviewers' repairs a real turn-1 ambiguity. The no-cell-edit branch is correct against git, not merely against its own text: the sole file-08 commit at or after D-170 is D-236, which the branch excludes, and the prior one is D-169, below the floor. The naming attribution survives three separate challenges — gate-harness-naming v7 and v8 were never recorded, D-159 governs the DR-117 EE lineage rather than DR-G21, and D-147 named DR-G23, so D-145 / naming v6 is the correct G21 parent and the subject switched off the G23 run's D-147 rather than copying it forward. The fixtures invent nothing: NT-1 is the delivery.v2 frameEnvelope field set with a frameType outside the live closed vocabulary, and NT-2 adds the member name 'findings' quoted verbatim from provider-only-output-contract.v3 NT-2 input, whose own outputLaw states no finding schema is invented. Live readiness figures recompute — 5 of 32, 28 of 28 named, 32 of 32 owners, condition 5 last — and DR-G21, DR-114 and DR-133 remain OPEN. Zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX, zero SHOULD-FIX.
